text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With her sights set on next year's<n>Classic Triple
Crown, Rudolf is<n>already training with even greater
intensity than before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While I understand her reasoning, I'd<n>at least like
her to rest during her<n>breaks...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I see. That should be the last of<n>the
equipment inquiries.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Looking over student requests. I<n>asked my
vice-president to collate<n>them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ever since we set up an online<n>submission form,
we've been<n>receiving more opinions than ever.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We will continue to maintain our<n>physical
submissions box, of course,<n>but the administration
has a<n>responsibility to adapt our methods to<n>the
times.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She seems pleased enough, but<n>spending her
break time doing<n>student council work can't be
good<n>for her health.
choice_data_list: You should try and get some actual rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your concern is appreciated, but I'm<n>afraid this is
something of a<n>constitutional defect of mine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Without a job to do, I get so restless<n>that I make
myself more exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Being a workaholic is in my nature.<n>I'd appreciate
it if you could take that<n>for what it is.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to put my foot down when<n>she phrases it
like that. As I'm<n>wondering how to respond...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President?! I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, Air Groove. Is something the<n>matter?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You're the matter. I was under theimpression that you were trainingtoday.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's right. I told you this morning,<n>didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed you did. Which is why I<n>specifically
messaged you to say that<n>you should look over
those requests<n>in the evening.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And yet, for some reason, I got a<n>message that
the job was already<n>done. I thought it was
strange, so I<n>dropped by the office, and what do I
find?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What can I say? I found myself free<n>during my
break and thought I might<n>as well start on it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're free during break time<n>because you're
supposed to be<n>resting!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your concern, but there's<n>no need to
get so worked up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, how am I to introduce you<n>to my trainer
as my calm and reliable<n>right hand?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, Trainer, allow me<n>to introduce
you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This is Air Groove, my vice-president.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She is a proud and noble compatriot<n>who pursues
a dream very similar to<n>my own.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Charmed, I'm sure.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
(Air Groove, a racer also known as<n>the Empress,
is a big name in Tracen<n>Academy in her own right.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This will be far from the last time you<n>see each
other, so you may as well<n>get to know one
another.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's one other member of the<n>student council
who I had hoped to<n>introduce you to, but... all in
good time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's all well and good, President.<n>However,
we're not finished<n>speaking.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware of your inclination to<n>do
everything yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All the same, I would appreciate it if<n>you would at
least let me decide<n>which tasks should take
priority.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
With the volume of requests we're<n>receiving
lately, you can't possibly<n>review them all and still
have time for<n>your other obligations.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But that will do nothing but increase<n>your own
workload.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying that I should offload<n>my
responsibilities onto your<n>shoulders?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I... No. Knowing you, you will find a<n>solution on your
own.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you understand. Now, don't<n>worry about
me. Focus on the jobs I<n>have assigned you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But for today, at least, you must set<n>your duties
aside and focus on<n>training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Are we agreed?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We are.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good. Now, I ought to be going. My<n>apologies for
the interruption.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A veritable wunderkind, is she not? I<n>count myself
lucky to work alongside<n>someone so capable.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And as such, I suppose I must pay<n>heed to her
advice. I will focus on<n>training for the rest of the
day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Could you add more weights to the<n>barbell,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I can still go higher. What's the point<n>in training
without pushing myself to<n>the limit?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm certainly going to feel that<n>tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But when it comes to weight training, I<n>try to... set
the bar high.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...That's rather good, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After a thoroughly exhausting training<n>session,
we're walking together<n>around the academy
when...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Stop for a moment if you would,<n>Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm. I thought as much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian! How is that assignment coming<n>along?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf abruptly shouts up into<n>the
branches of a nearby tree.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Rustle rustle...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume leaps down from the<n>tree!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: How did you know I was there?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I heard a faint noise from above as<n>we
approached.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's only one person in Tracen<n>Academy who
would try to hide from<n>me in such an audacious
manner.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ugh.... Nothing gets past you, huh?<n>That's half the
reason I was hiding.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha. Come on, don't be so prickly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, allow me to introduce you to<n>Narita Brian,
the other student council<n>member I mentioned
earlier. I suspect<n>you might have heard of her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
(I certainly have. Narita Brian is a<n>racing
powerhouse on par with Air<n>Groove.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If that's all, then I'll be going.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not so fast. You still haven't<n>answered my
question. Have you<n>finished the equipment
inspection?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll get to it. Speaking of which...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Dunno what it is, but that general<n>manager kid's
got something on her<n>mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The general manager? I see. I'll<n>speak to her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: See you 'round.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She might seem haughty at first, but<n>she's much
more caring than she<n>lets on. There are many
jobs that<n>only she can do.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Still, the general manager... Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Quite the opposite, actually. She only<n>joined the
student council recently.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, I inspired her so much<n>that she
wanted to join me in making<n>a difference at the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She's been struggling to get used to<n>the work, so
the rest of us have been<n>looking out for her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But her enthusiasm is quite enough<n>on its own.
And having somebody on<n>the council who looks
up to me<n>pushes me to be better, too.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
My biggest accomplishment of the<n>day ends up
being learning about<n>Symboli Rudolf's relation with
the<n>other members of the student council.
